candidates.change_summary: Change the reentrancy guard to skip unlocking after function body, leaving _locked true and preventing further airDrop effects for other calls.
Remove the hasNoBalance modifier from airDrop so callers with existing balances can receive additional tokens, changing which tokenBalance entries can change.
Change supportsToken to compare to a different string, making the modifier fail for the legitimate Bank and preventing airDrop from executing.
Invert hasNoBalance to require the caller already has a positive balance, allowing only existing holders to receive the airdrop and preventing new addresses from receiving tokens.

Remove the reentrancy lock by deleting setting _locked = true so the modifier no longer prevents reentrant calls (only sets back to false), enabling reentrancy and changing airDrop's observable final tokenBalance.
Change the amount added in airDrop from 20 to 40 so callers receive different tokenBalance after the call.
Alter supportsToken to require a different token name so the supportsToken modifier fails for the original Bank implementation, preventing airDrop and changing the observed balance.
Relax hasNoBalance to allow non-zero balances by removing the require, letting airDrop be callable repeatedly and changing final tokenBalance.
